purpose: authored cross-domain inference evaluation; not training or representative workplace accuracy

cases.rationale: Two authors describe membership in the Solar System. Membership has a direction.

posts.body: Earth is part of the Solar System. The Sun is also part of the Solar System and lies at its center.
Our astronomy chart identifies Earth as part of the Solar System. The Sun is part of the Solar System, along with its planets and smaller bodies.

cases.rationale: Two explicit definitions support an acronym. Two descriptions support use of an instrument.

posts.body: The Hubble Space Telescope (HST) uses gyroscopes to measure changes in its orientation.
For pointing control, the Hubble Space Telescope (HST) uses gyroscopes that detect its rotation.

cases.rationale: Negated production statements identify topics but do not support a positive production claim.

posts.body: The Moon does not produce sunlight. We see sunlight reflected from the lunar surface.
The Moon never produces sunlight of its own. Its bright appearance comes from reflected light.

cases.rationale: Questions and conditional proposals supply topics without establishing a deployed capability.

posts.body: Should Mars exploration use nuclear power for a future crewed outpost?
If Mars exploration uses nuclear power, how would the equipment be transported?

cases.rationale: Two different contributors report the same concrete software use without implying its reverse.

posts.body: Our FastAPI deployment uses Pydantic to validate incoming request fields.
In the API service I maintain, FastAPI uses Pydantic for typed request validation.

cases.rationale: Literal dependency evidence distinguishes the framework from its required runtime.

posts.body: Django requires Python to execute our web application.
The installation guide records that Django depends on Python for its runtime.

cases.rationale: Production describes an output of a configured render workflow, with the output as the tail.

posts.body: In our render workflow, Blender produces OpenEXR for the compositing stage.
The animation export task confirms that Blender produces OpenEXR with the selected output settings.

cases.rationale: Replacement evidence names both the new and old technology and preserves their direction.

posts.body: In the workshop renovation, LED lighting replaces fluorescent lighting above the assembly benches.
The completed workshop upgrade uses a new fixture layout. LED lighting replaces fluorescent lighting throughout that room.

cases.rationale: Passive wording reverses text order but keeps the worker as the user of the broker.

posts.body: Redis is used by Celery as the broker in our background task deployment.
For the scheduled task queue, Redis is used by Celery to carry pending jobs.

cases.rationale: Equipment listed together can have a weak association without a typed factual relationship.

posts.body: The bench inventory lists a soldering iron beside a digital multimeter. Each has its own storage tray.
I checked the serial numbers of the digital multimeter and the soldering iron during the equipment audit.

cases.rationale: Several differently worded posts by one person remain one independent source group.

posts.body: Docker uses Linux in the container host that I configured.
The operating system check confirms that Docker uses Linux on this host.
I recorded the host configuration in the runbook: Docker uses Linux for our container deployment.

cases.rationale: Exact copies from different people cannot supply independent alias or relationship support.

posts.body: Our Arduino uses Pulse-Width Modulation (PWM) to control the indicator brightness.
Our Arduino uses Pulse-Width Modulation (PWM) to control the indicator brightness.
Our Arduino uses Pulse-Width Modulation (PWM) to control the indicator brightness.

cases.rationale: Independent, explicit definitions can establish an acronym and a supported use relationship.

posts.body: The Arduino uses Pulse-Width Modulation (PWM) for the dimmable indicator in my prototype.
On the demonstration board, Arduino uses Pulse-Width Modulation (PWM) to set the duty cycle of the indicator output.

cases.rationale: Two established expansions of one acronym must remain contextual even with two authors per expansion.

posts.body: A Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) handles the conveyor interlocks in the assembly cell.
The maintenance checklist identifies the Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) that monitors the assembly cell inputs.
Power Line Communication (PLC) carries data over the electrical wiring in our networking demonstration.
The networking lesson explains Power Line Communication (PLC) with a pair of adapters on existing electrical wiring.

cases.rationale: A hyphen and a space preserve the same words. Repeated independent variant evidence can establish an alias.

posts.body: The cable repair kit contains heat-shrink tubing in several diameters.
We added heat-shrink tubing to the workshop stock list for cable repairs.
The packaging label calls the same repair material heat shrink tubing.
The supplier lists heat shrink tubing by diameter in its cable repair section.

cases.rationale: Meaningful punctuation distinguishes programming languages and must not create a spelling alias.

posts.body: C++ and C# are distinct programming languages. Our training catalog gives each language its own course.
The code review checklist has separate sections for C# and C++. They name different languages.

cases.rationale: Private posts cannot publish concepts or relationships even when their content would otherwise provide repeated support.

posts.body: My private Home Assistant installation uses Mosquitto to exchange messages with the workshop devices.
In my private setup notes, Home Assistant uses Mosquitto as the message broker for the garage sensors.

cases.rationale: An explicit contradiction prevents automatic activation of a claim despite two positive sources.

posts.body: Grafana uses Prometheus for the metrics displayed on our operations dashboard.
The dashboard configuration notes say Grafana uses Prometheus to retrieve operational metrics.
Grafana does not use Prometheus in the operations dashboard configuration I inspected.

cases.rationale: After both supporting posts are edited, the removed names and claim have no remaining source support.

posts.body: Home Assistant uses Zigbee for the workshop temperature sensors.
The sensor configuration confirms that Home Assistant uses Zigbee for workshop telemetry.

actions.body: The workshop inspection ended at noon.
The weekly maintenance checklist is complete.

cases.rationale: Deleting every supporting post withdraws its automatic concepts and relationship.

posts.body: Restic uses SFTP to reach the backup repository on our archive host.
The backup job configuration shows that Restic uses SFTP for archive transfers.

cases.rationale: An accepted answer and two different helpful contributions provide three original items and outcomes from two people.

posts.body: How can I investigate slow queries in PostgreSQL?
For PostgreSQL query diagnosis, I compared the execution plan with the table statistics and identified the missing index.
I documented the PostgreSQL backup verification process and tested restoration into an empty database.
I traced a PostgreSQL lock wait to a long transaction and recorded the session information in the incident notes.

cases.rationale: The same outcome requirements apply to practical workshop knowledge as to software topics.

posts.body: How do we document soldering defects during the workshop inspection?
For the soldering inspection, I added photographs of the joint defects to the checklist and linked each photograph to its board location.
I prepared a soldering practice record that separates the inspection result from the operator's notes.
I organized the soldering rework history by board identifier so the next inspection can trace previous repairs.

cases.rationale: One accepted answer remains one original contribution even when two people give positive outcomes.

posts.body: Where can I inspect the render output settings in Blender?
In Blender, I checked the output properties and recorded the selected file format in the render checklist.

cases.rationale: Several topic-specific questions identify an interest but supply no expertise outcomes.

posts.body: How does orbital mechanics describe a spacecraft transfer between Earth and Mars?
Which part of orbital mechanics explains the shape of an elliptical orbit?
How is orbital mechanics used to compare two possible transfer orbits?
